answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A shinty club membership with league fixture logs works as the gate: fixtures logged with one club across seasons. The price is per head, and the juniper test proves it: Each of 90 aliases needs its own fixture logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The atlas trail is public, the bridge check is cheap to run, and a farm of 90 aliases pays 90 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
